messages:
ana: Quick alert 1: cosign verify on base-image shows signer 'ci-runner' with prod key. Digest sha256:abc123deadbeef. Not promoted yet but we should triage RBAC/KMS.
tom: Which pipeline pushed it? link?
ana: push from projects/artifacts/builds/5555 tag base-core:2026-04-02. build: https://artifacts.example/builds/5555
sam: Paste cosign verify output?
ana: ```
Verified OK : sha256:abc123deadbeef
Signed by: ci-runner@redwood
Key: projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/images/cryptoKeys/prod-main/cryptoKeyVersions/6
```
tom: Immediate: add digest to denylist, revoke ci-runner KMS sign binding temporarily, and schedule snapshot of the builder for forensics.
ops-bot: denylist updated: sha256:abc123deadbeef added (TTL 72h)
sam: Short-term mitigation: rebuild with non-root base, strip any suid bits, sign with rotated key version and include cosign attest predicate with pipeline id. Also add runtime prestart OCI hook to `cosign verify` and emit structured audit.
tom: I'll file the IAM rotation ticket and take ownership of removing ci-runner from prod KMS binding. Ticket SEC-5001 created and assigned to tom, sam.
ana: Scheduling 15-min sync in 10m to align on rebuild and audit export. Will update thread after.
